thread:
maya: FYI we're doing a compact change window tonight 02:00-02:20 UTC. Plan: wave1 = API + Router header swap, wave2 = Runtime kernel-toggle + Console schema. Need confirmed pin order + rollback owner.

 ash: ack. i'm nervous about header negotiation. router and api MUST be compatible for 0-RTT clients.

 intan: compatibility matrix updated in the doc. Router 1.10 supports both header formats behind flag. if we flip router early, we should keep API canary low.

 maya: proposed sequence: 1) API -> pin 2.5.0 (canary 5% for 3m), 2) Router -> pin 2.0.0 (30% then 70%), 3) Runtime -> kernel batching ON, 4) Console -> schema rollout (gradual). Rollback plan: immediate router unpin -> traffic backfill to router-legacy; if that fails unpin API and revert runtime kernel flag.

 ron: who runs the traffic shift and who has the keys for router pool? ron: ops will run the pool shift, i'm aligned to execute.

 ash: trigger thresholds: if /v1/generate p95 > 250ms or error rate > 0.5% for 5m -> rollback. Also watch :router_hdr_negotiation_fail metric.

 deploybot: DeployBot: preflight OK. pins: API=2.5.0, Router=2.0.0. Quiet window reserved: 02:00-02:20 UTC.

 intan: running staging smoke now. curl test and header shim check:
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging-router.redwood.internal/echo -H "x-router-version: v2" -d '{"hi":1}' | jq .
```
intan: staging returned 200 and header echo v2. no negotiation errors.

 deploybot: DeployBot: canary started: API 2.5.0 -> 5% traffic. p95=95ms, errors=0

 maya: moving to 30% router shift in 3m if canary stable. ron will run pool shift and call out.

 ron: starting router traffic move to 30% now. ops note: using staged-handoff script.

 deploybot: DeployBot: router pinned to 2.0.0, traffic 30%. monitor :router_hdr_negotiation_fail=0.01% p95 change +10ms.

 ash: small latency bump but within tolerance. continue.

 maya: proceeding to runtime toggle after 10m steady. intan please watch KV cache hit-rate; console team watch schema warnings.

 deploybot: DeployBot: runtime kernel batching flag toggled ON in canary pool. sampling shows no regressions.

 ron: oncall ready. rollback keys are in ops runbook. if rollback, i'll revert router traffic and notify @eng-sre.

 maya: final: console schema rollout starts now. will post release notes to #release-notes after window. thanks all. :rocket:

 deploybot: DeployBot: window completed. final state: API=2.5.0 (p95=110ms), Router=2.0.0 (p95 diff +12ms), Runtime=batching=ON, Console schema=gradual. no rollbacks executed.
